faqs.question: Why are Node.js developers in high demand?
faqs.answer: Node.js uses an event-driven, non-blocking I/O model that makes it lightweight and efficient, perfect for data-intensive real-time applications that run across distributed devices.

faqs.question: Is Node.js suitable for enterprise-scale applications?
faqs.answer: Yes! Major enterprises like Netflix, Uber, PayPal, and LinkedIn rely on Node.js for its ability to handle millions of simultaneous requests with minimal server resource consumption.

faqs.question: What databases pair best with Node.js?
faqs.answer: Node.js works seamlessly with both SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB) depending on project requirements.

faqs.question: Can you migrate our existing PHP or Python backend to Node.js?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have extensive experience refactoring legacy backend monolithic systems into modern, modular Node.js microservices with zero operational downtime.

faqs.question: How do you ensure high security in Node.js applications?
faqs.answer: We implement Helmet security headers, rate limiting, JWT authentication, input validation, automated npm audit vulnerability checks, and role-based access control (RBAC).
